headline: 15 of 16 phase-anchor policies have exact rational rank 1179; the unique failure is the true block-grid-consistent policy (0,1), whose exact rational rank is 1144.
interpretation_limits: This does not prove boundary-straddling is the causal reason for full observability.
Random raw-history refinements of the grid partition can also recover the 35-dimensional hidden space with high probability at comparable granularity.
The result is a finite-system descriptor degeneracy theorem, not a general Abelian-geometry theorem.
